title: GLM-4.5: Agentic, Reasoning, and Coding (ARC) Foundation Models
paper_type_zh: 前沿 ARC 基座模型技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 需要审计前沿推理、代码和 agent 模型的数据来源、反馈契约、轨迹筛选、环境依赖与发布边界的读者
one_line: GLM-4.5 discloses a broad 23T-token ARC training and post-training pipeline with expert self-distillation, verifier/reward/judge feedback, and agent environments, but releases weights and inference materials rather than the source data, RM/Judge artifacts, replayable environments, or audit records needed for independent verification.
GLM-4.5 披露了约 23T token 的 ARC 训练与后训练框架，包含专家自蒸馏、验证器/奖励/裁判反馈和 agent 环境；但官方发布的是权重与推理材料，而非原始语料、RM/Judge 工件、可回放环境或审计记录。
why: It makes the distinction Track 12 needs: a detailed frontier-model narrative and MIT model release can reveal useful high-level data and feedback interfaces, yet they do not establish access to the original data, reward/judge contract, environment state, provenance, licenses, decontamination evidence, or reproducible training process.
inclusion_reason: A high-impact frontier technical report that materially describes data construction, expert iteration, mixed feedback, and agent-training infrastructure while leaving the released model weights far short of a reproducible or independently auditable data-and-feedback release.

title: Problem
问题
html:
GLM-4.5 is a frontier ARC (agentic, reasoning, and coding) model report whose training narrative spans web-scale pre-training, code and reasoning continuation, expert-model iteration, mixed reinforcement learning, tool use, and agent environments. For an auditable reasoning-data atlas, the question is not whether the released model is capable: it is which data objects, feedback contracts, environments, and audits can actually be inspected or reused.

The report provides unusually broad high-level disclosure, but the official release boundary is critical. Official weights, inference integrations, and model documentation do not constitute a release of the original corpus, post-training data, reward model, LLM Judge, agent environment, source-rights evidence, or evaluation-leakage audit. This Card records both the disclosed pipeline and those missing artifacts.

GLM-4.5 是一份覆盖 agent、推理和代码（ARC）的前沿模型报告：其训练叙事涉及网页级预训练、代码与推理续训、专家模型迭代、混合强化学习、工具调用和 agent 环境。对可审计的推理数据图谱而言，关键不是已发布模型是否强，而是哪些数据对象、反馈契约、环境与审计材料能够真正被检查或复用。

报告给出了较广泛的高层披露，但发布边界同样关键。官方权重、推理集成和模型文档并不等于已发布原始语料、后训练数据、奖励模型、LLM Judge、agent 环境、来源权利证明或评测泄漏审计。本 Card 同时记录已披露的管线和这些未发布工件。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The report describes a multi-stage path from broad pre-training to code/reasoning, long-context, and agent-oriented data, followed by separate reasoning, agent, and general expert models. A second stage unifies those experts by self-distillation into hybrid thinking and direct-response behavior.

Its feedback contract is explicitly mixed. Objective answers, executable tests, function-call rules, and environment completion contribute rule-based signals; reward models filter subjective cases; human preference annotations support RLHF; model feedback supports RLAIF; and some end-to-end agent tasks rely on an LLM Judge. The disclosed architecture of the contract is useful, while its executable specifications remain unavailable.

报告描述了从广泛预训练到代码/推理、长上下文和 agent 导向数据的多阶段路径，随后分别训练推理、agent 和通用专家模型；第二阶段再通过自蒸馏把这些专家统一为兼具思考与直接回答能力的模型。

其反馈契约明确是混合式的：客观答案、可执行测试、函数调用规则和环境完成状态提供规则信号；奖励模型筛除主观样本；人工偏好标注支撑 RLHF；模型反馈支撑 RLAIF；部分端到端 agent 任务还依赖 LLM Judge。反馈架构本身已披露，但可执行的具体规范尚未发布。

title: Method
方法
html:
For pre-training, the report names crawled Chinese and English web pages, social media, books, papers, and code repositories. It describes quality bucketing, upsampling, MinHash and semantic deduplication, language- and domain-specific quality models, and code-aware processing. Its figure reports nominal components of 15T general-pretraining tokens, 7T code/reasoning continual-pretraining tokens, 500B repository code tokens, 500B synthetic-reasoning tokens, and 100B long-context/agent tokens; the text summarizes the total as about 23T tokens.

Post-training starts from small cold-start SFT and grows to millions of expert-generated reasoning, chat, agent, and long-context samples. Rejection filters remove malformed or short reasoning, check objective answers, apply reward models to subjective responses, and retain tool trajectories that obey protocol and reach expected terminal states. Agent SFT uses real API/MCP tools alongside constructed or simulated tools, generated tasks, existing tool-call trajectories, user simulation, and judge-agent success filtering.

Reasoning RL uses a GRPO-style approach without a KL term. Agentic RL uses web QA and software-engineering tasks with environment feedback; general RL mixes rules, human preference feedback, and model feedback. Exact prompts, datasets, reward aggregation, rollout configurations, and production schedules are not released.

预训练部分列举了中英文爬取网页、社交媒体、书籍、论文和代码仓库，并描述质量分桶与上采样、MinHash 与语义去重、语言/领域质量模型及面向代码的处理。图中给出名义规模：15T 通用预训练 token、7T 代码/推理续训 token、500B 仓库代码 token、500B 合成推理 token 和 100B 长上下文/agent token；正文将总规模概括为约 23T token。

后训练先从小型冷启动 SFT 开始，再扩展到数百万级专家生成的推理、对话、agent 和长上下文样本。拒绝筛选会移除格式错误或过短的推理，核验客观答案，用奖励模型筛选主观回答，并保留协议合规且达到预期终态的工具轨迹。Agent SFT 同时使用真实 API/MCP 工具与构造/模拟工具、生成任务、既有工具调用轨迹、用户模拟和裁判 agent 的成功筛选。

推理 RL 使用不含 KL 项的 GRPO 式方法；agentic RL 使用带环境反馈的网页问答和软件工程任务；通用 RL 混合规则、人工偏好和模型反馈。具体提示词、数据集、奖励聚合、rollout 配置和生产调度均未发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official arXiv record is the primary evidence for the data categories, 23T-token training claim, expert-model iteration, SFT filtering, reasoning RL, agentic RL, and mixed general-RL feedback summarized in this Card.

The official Z.ai GLM-4.5 documentation confirms the public model family and its documented deployment characteristics. The official zai-org/GLM-4.5 repository and zai-org/GLM-4.5 model page verify that model releases and inference/integration material are public and state MIT for the released model variants.

These sources do not verify a public release of the training corpora, post-training prompts or traces, reward models, judge prompts or calibration, tool/API snapshots, agent environments, raw experiment logs, source-level licenses, or a decontamination audit. Those items are therefore recorded as unknown or unreleased, rather than inferred from released weights.

官方 arXiv 记录 是本 Card 中数据类别、23T token 训练声明、专家模型迭代、SFT 筛选、推理 RL、agentic RL 和混合通用 RL 反馈的主要依据。

官方 Z.ai GLM-4.5 文档 确认了公开模型系列及其部署特征。官方 zai-org/GLM-4.5 仓库 和 zai-org/GLM-4.5 模型页 验证模型发布以及推理/集成材料公开，并标明已发布模型变体为 MIT。

这些来源没有验证训练语料、后训练提示词或轨迹、奖励模型、Judge 提示词或校准、工具/API 快照、agent 环境、原始实验日志、来源级许可证或去污染审计的公开发布。因此这些事项被如实记录为 unknown 或未发布，而不会从已发布权重中推断出来。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For Track 12, the useful contribution is the breadth of the disclosed ledger rather than a claim that the training artifacts are open. One report links web-scale source processing, synthetic reasoning, repository-level code, long-context/agent material, expert self-distillation, verifier and reward filtering, tool trajectories, and mixed RL feedback.

This makes GLM-4.5 a useful disclosure case: it exposes enough interfaces to identify what should be audited, while also making the unreleased dependencies visible. It should not be treated as a released reasoning-data recipe merely because the weights and inference integrations are public.

对 Track12 而言，值得关注的是披露账本覆盖面的广度，而不是把它误称为开放训练工件。单份报告串联了网页级来源处理、合成推理、仓库级代码、长上下文/agent 材料、专家自蒸馏、验证器和奖励筛选、工具轨迹以及混合 RL 反馈。

这使 GLM-4.5 成为有价值的披露案例：它公开了足以识别审计对象的接口，同时也清楚暴露了未发布依赖。即使权重和推理集成公开，也不应把它当作已经发布的推理数据配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The report does not provide source manifests, crawl dates, source proportions, data licenses, consent or PII treatment, teacher/reward/judge identities, prompts, filtering thresholds, retention rates, or rejected samples. It mentions deduplication but does not disclose a benchmark-overlap audit.

The agent loop is also not replayable from the official release: API/MCP inventories, tool snapshots, sandbox images, AgentGym configurations, task instances, action schemas, terminal predicates, and execution logs are unavailable. Model weights under an MIT release do not resolve any of these missing data, feedback, environment, or audit dependencies.

报告未提供来源清单、爬取日期、来源比例、数据许可证、同意或 PII 处理、教师/奖励/Judge 身份、提示词、筛选阈值、保留率或被拒绝样本。它提到去重，但未公开基准重叠审计。

官方发布也无法回放 agent 闭环：API/MCP 清单、工具快照、沙箱镜像、AgentGym 配置、任务实例、动作 schema、终态判定和执行日志均不可用。MIT 发布的模型权重不能弥补这些尚缺的数据、反馈、环境和审计依赖。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this Card to compare frontier reports by disclosure quality: which source categories are named, which feedback signals are executable, where model or judge feedback enters, and which artifacts are required to reproduce or audit an agent-training claim.

It is especially useful for separating a model release from a data release. Researchers can cite the report for its high-level construction account, but should not claim access to the original training corpus, post-training data, reward/judge contract, agent environment, or contamination evidence without a later official release.

可用本 Card 按披露质量比较前沿报告：哪些来源类别被点名，哪些反馈信号可执行，模型或裁判反馈在哪个环节进入，以及复现或审计 agent 训练主张还需要哪些工件。

它尤其有助于区分“模型发布”和“数据发布”。研究者可以引用报告中的高层构建说明，但在后续官方发布出现前，不应声称可获得原始训练语料、后训练数据、奖励/Judge 契约、agent 环境或去污染证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read sections 2 and 3 of the technical report together. The reported RL objectives only become interpretable alongside the data-construction, filtering, and expert-iteration path.
  • Keep feedback types separate: objective checks and executable tests are not equivalent to reward-model scores, human preferences, or LLM-Judge outcomes.
  • Treat “semantic deduplication” as corpus processing, not as proof of benchmark decontamination.
  • Treat the MIT release as a fact about released model variants. It is not evidence that upstream data, generated traces, reward artifacts, environments, or audit records are licensed or public.

• 应把技术报告第 2 节和第 3 节一起读：只有结合数据构建、筛选和专家迭代路径，RL 目标才可被正确理解。
  • 应区分各类反馈：客观核验和可执行测试，不等同于奖励模型分数、人工偏好或 LLM-Judge 结果。
  • “语义去重”只是语料处理，不是基准去污染的证据。
  • MIT 发布是已发布模型变体的许可证事实；它不能证明上游数据、生成轨迹、奖励工件、环境或审计记录已获许可或已公开。
